crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

translations.bsb: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
translations.kjv: How long, LORD? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?
